title: Add account to my event stream
description: Add a Customer Analytics account to the caller's event stream so its users' matching events start posting to their Slack channel. Provide the stream `id` and the `account_id` to add. Idempotent — adding an account that is already in the stream is a no-op. Only accounts with an `external_id` actually deliver (the external_id is how events are matched to the account).

methodDocumentation.text:
The caller's event stream: a live feed of selected accounts' events posted to a
Slack channel of their choice. Per-user — each team member owns at most one stream, and
every endpoint is scoped to the caller's own. Delivery runs through a managed CDP
destination that is re-provisioned inside the same transaction as every write, so
config and delivery can't drift apart.

Add a Customer Analytics account to the caller's event stream so its users' matching events start posting to their Slack channel. Provide the stream `id` and the `account_id` to add. Idempotent — adding an account that is already in the stream is a no-op. Only accounts with an `external_id` actually deliver (the external_id is how events are matched to the account).
